verses.text: In the first year that Belshazzar was king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream, and visions passed through his mind as he lay in bed. He wrote down the dream, telling the main points.
Daniel said, "In my vision at night I looked, and I saw the four winds of heaven stirring up the great sea.
Four huge beasts came up out of the sea, each one different from the others.

"The first was like a lion, and it had the wings of an eagle. I watched until its wings were torn off. It was lifted from the ground and made to stand on two feet like a human, and it was given a human mind.
"Then I saw a second beast, which looked like a bear. It was raised up on one of its sides, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. It was told, 'Get up and eat all the meat you want!'

"After that, I looked, and there before me was another beast, which looked like a leopard. On its back it had four wings like those of a bird. This beast had four heads, and it was given authority to rule.

"After that, in my vision at night, I looked, and there before me was a fourth beast. It was terrifying, frightening, and very powerful. It had large iron teeth. It crushed and devoured its victims and trampled whatever was left under its feet. It was different from all the beasts before it, and it had ten horns.

"While I was thinking about the horns, I saw another horn, a little one, coming up among them. Three of the first horns were pulled up by the roots to make room for it. This horn had eyes like the eyes of a human and a mouth that bragged with great pride.

"As I looked, thrones were set in place, and the Ancient of Days took his seat. His clothing was as white as snow, and the hair of his head was like pure wool. His throne was blazing with fire, and its wheels were all on fire.
A river of fire was flowing, coming out from before him. Thousands upon thousands served him. Ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him. The court was seated, and the books were opened.
"Then I kept watching because of the proud words the horn was speaking. I kept looking until the beast was killed and its body destroyed and thrown into the blazing fire.
The other beasts had their authority taken away, but they were allowed to live for a period of time.
"In my vision at night I looked, and there before me was one like a son of man, coming with the clouds of heaven. He came up to the Ancient of Days and was led into his presence.
He was given authority, glory, and a kingdom. People of every nation and language worshiped him. His rule is a rule that lasts forever and will never pass away. His kingdom will never be destroyed.
"As for me, Daniel, I was deeply troubled in spirit, and the visions that passed through my mind frightened me.
I went up to one of those standing there and asked him what all this really meant. So he told me and explained the meaning of these things:
'The four huge beasts are four kings who will rise from the earth.
But the holy people of the Most High will receive the kingdom and will own it forever, yes, forever and ever.'

"Then I wanted to know what the fourth beast really meant. It was different from all the others and very terrifying, with its iron teeth and bronze claws. It crushed and devoured its victims and trampled whatever was left under its feet.

I also wanted to know about the ten horns on its head, and about the other horn that came up, which made three of the horns fall. That horn had eyes and a mouth that bragged with great pride, and it looked bigger than the others.
As I watched, this horn was waging war against the holy people and defeating them,
until the Ancient of Days came and judged in favor of the holy people of the Most High. Then the time came when the holy people took over the kingdom.
"He explained, 'The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom that will appear on earth. It will be different from all the other kingdoms. It will devour the whole earth, trampling it down and crushing it.
The ten horns are ten kings who will come from this kingdom. After them another king will rise, different from the earlier ones. He will bring down three kings.

He will speak against the Most High and wear down the holy people of the Most High. He will try to change the set times and the laws. The holy people will be handed over to him for a time, times, and half a time.
"'But the court will sit, and his power will be taken away and completely destroyed forever.

Then the rule, the power, and the greatness of all the kingdoms under heaven will be given to the holy people of the Most High. His kingdom will last forever, and all rulers will worship and obey him.'
"This is the end of the account. I, Daniel, was deeply troubled by my thoughts, and my face turned pale, but I kept the matter to myself."
